live.note: Frozen before tip-off with that day's injury report, graded after the game.

spread.breakeven_note: About 52.4% is needed to beat standard -110 betting prices.

backfill_2026_27.note: Made after the fact, walk-forward (only earlier games used), knowing who played. Benchmarks = FanDuel closing chance and Prop Edge's published chance (which is partly blended with the market), as Prop Edge saved them.

players_live.note: Players projected 20+ minutes; average miss vs the season-average baseline on the same players.

vs_kalshi.note: Kalshi main line (tight quote nearest 50%); OVER chance at that line. Brier: lower is better.

players_backtest_2025_26.tested_on: 2025-26 regular season, projected 20+ min (never seen in tuning)

player_log.note: calls = [stat, line, o/u, Teleios over chance, market over chance, 1 if right]; in80 = stats (of 5) inside the 80% range
